title: Dispatch Brief Contract
description: Machine-checkable form of the Dispatch Brief Contract. Grounded verbatim in conductor/dispatch-brief.md ('The Six Required Fields', 'Decomposition Rule', 'Destructive Operations — Mandatory 3-Step Dispatch', 'Recommended Optional Field — Prior Incidents') and the machine-key mapping conductor/orchestra-model.md §3.1 uses for a crew-plan task's `brief:` block ('the six-field Dispatch Brief Contract — VERBATIM REQUIRED'). Phase 0 of ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md, Design Decision #3 ('Contracts become schemas'): an instance that fails this schema is a schema-miss, classified degraded_output by `tessctl validate` per conductor/subagent-failure-protocol.md.

objective.description: dispatch-brief.md field 1 — one sentence describing success for THIS agent, not the mission overall.

output_contract.description: dispatch-brief.md field 2 — file path, format, required sections. Not "a good analysis" but "a markdown file at [path] with sections [X, Y, Z]".

tools_sources_constraints.description: dispatch-brief.md field 3 — tools/primary-artifact pointers/constraints. Carries the evidence requirement: every factual claim in the return must be grounded in a primary artifact the agent itself read or a tool call it itself ran; inference must be labeled as inference.

not_responsible_for.description: dispatch-brief.md field 4 — the one line that prevents scope bleed into the adjacent agent's territory.

milestones.description: dispatch-brief.md field 5 — required for tasks estimated >15 minutes or production-touching (Decomposition Rule); optional otherwise. Modeled as an always-present key (empty array when the rule does not apply) so the contract stays deterministic; see the conditional requirement below.

acceptance_evidence.description: Named acceptance-evidence artifact: tool output, file diff, curl response, test result.

escalation_trigger.description: dispatch-brief.md field 6 — the condition that requires the agent to stop and surface to the conductor rather than proceeding.

prod_touching.description: Phase-0 machine-checkable proxy for the Decomposition Rule's 'or touching production' trigger. Not itself one of the prose six fields — added so the milestones-required condition is schema-enforceable rather than left to model judgment.

estimated_minutes.description: Phase-0 machine-checkable proxy for the Decomposition Rule's '>15 minutes' trigger.

destructive.description: Marks a brief covering a destructive operation. dispatch-brief.md: 'Never one-shot a destructive operation' — the mandatory 3-step pattern (verify/snapshot → report + go/no-go → execute) is a dispatch-sequencing rule the conductor enforces across the three dispatches; this flag lets a gate spine detect a destructive brief that skips straight to an execute-only step (see `step` below).

step.description: Which leg of the mandatory 3-step destructive dispatch this brief is (only meaningful when destructive: true).

prior_incidents.description: dispatch-brief.md 'Recommended Optional Field — Prior Incidents': relevant memory/feedback_* lessons pulled into the brief.

then.$comment: Operationalizes the Decomposition Rule: 'Any task estimated at more than 15 minutes or touching production is decomposed into milestones before dispatch.' A weak agent cannot satisfy the schema by declaring prod_touching:true or estimated_minutes>15 while leaving milestones empty.
